payload.description:
The pre-commit security audit intentionally removed user-controlled scoring IDs and exception text from log messages (log-injection / information-exposure mitigation). The HTTP response sanitization in plexus/workers/scoring_api.py is correct and must stay, but the server-side warning log now records only the status code. Operators can no longer correlate a failed request with a scoring job or see which resource was missing.

Restore operator diagnostics in server logs using injection-safe encoding (strip/escape newlines, or structured log fields) while keeping HTTP responses sanitized. Also: the generic handler binds an unused exception variable (`except Exception as exc:`), and consider letting self-authored static 4xx validation messages (e.g. 'scorecard is required') pass through to callers since they are not internal state.

```gherkin
Feature: Scoring API failure diagnostics
  Scenario: Known scoring failure is traceable in server logs
    Given a scoring request that references a missing resource
    When POST /v1/score returns a sanitized 4xx response
    Then the server log records the failure reason and a request correlation identifier in injection-safe form

  Scenario: Responses remain sanitized
    Given a scoring request that fails unexpectedly
    When the API responds
    Then the response body contains no internal exception text
```
payload.title: Scoring API error logs include sanitized failure diagnostics
